"Details" shows each profile's devices, last use, call name, change PIN, reset second step and delete; deleting now needs the fresh code like changing the PIN. The device list shows only the devices of the profiles shown,. Since V01.0.257 the profile of an own device key (script, shortcut) and of a new device is picked from a list of all profiles instead of typing a name; the iPhone app, speakers, Pebble watch and Home Assistant keys are set up by each profile itself under Me, show "🔒 fixed" with where they are managed, and can only be deleted here (the server refuses moving them too). "Last used" counts the browser login (without the address) and device keys. Call name: optional per profile ("Tom", "Dad"), set by the admin in the details or by the profile under Me → Messages; unique among all names and call names. Picking the recipient: in the envelope and under Me → Messages a field "To …": typing shows at most 8 matching prof

title: Many profiles (V01.0.206)
text: akers never talk during quiet hours. - Reading and replying: "Do I have messages?", then "Reply to her: coming" and "Yes". What a message says counts as outside text: it is only reported, locks everything that changes something for the rest of the answer and the next turn, and never goes into the memory. The panel takes the reply from your own words. - Announcement: "Announcement in the living room: dinner is ready" (or "everywhere"), after "Yes". A tone, then "Durchsage von …"; when the speaker is not connected, at its next wake word within ten minutes. - Voice message: Me → Messages → "Record" (at most 30 seconds), "Send". The speech recognition adds the text; it plays under Me → Messages or on the open page. - Limits: 500 characters, 30 messages an hour, 10 to the same person, 5 to everybody or announcements; 100 messages in the mailbox, deleted after 30 days. Text and recordings are stored encrypted on the Spark, never in the journal (only length and profile), and are not in backups.

head: Voice chat
title: Home Assistant Assist over Wyoming (V01.0.100)
text: Home Assistant Assist over Wyoming (V01.0.100): Home Assistant uses the Spark's speech recognition and voice (Voice PE, HA app, ESPHome speakers). Admin: Features → "Home Assistant Assist (Wyoming)" on and enter Home Assistant's address (Wyoming has no password; with no address listed the Spark answers nobody). Since V01.0.106 the field suggests the address from a profile's Home Assistant setup when switched on (home network addresses only; behind a reverse proxy enter the real HA address by hand) and shows addresses refused lately. In HA: integration "Wyoming Protocol", host = the Spark, port 31003; in the voice assistant pick "spark" for speech-to-text and text-to-speech. The service runs inside the panel, so it needs the full install. Since V01.0.334 Status → Live shows every transcription and every spoken answer for Home Assistant as a request of the device "Home Assistant" (way Hearing → text to Home Assistant, or Speaking → back), refused senders under Entrance; never the words.

head: Voice chat
title: Weather place
text: Weather place: postcode and place ("76307 Karlsbad") work; the name is searched in Germany and the postcode compared. When several places fit, the others can be picked; coordinates ("48.87, 8.50") work too.

head: Voice chat
title: Web search
text: Web search: switch on "Websuche" under Features and enter the address of your SearXNG instance right below it. If SearXNG's settings.yml allows json under search: formats:, the panel uses the JSON API, otherwise it reads the normal results page; "Test connection" shows whether it works. The LLM then searches by itself when a question needs current information (the LLM server needs tool calling; qwen38 has it on). The assistant says it is looking it up, reads the top pages and shows the sources under the answer. Since V01.0.130 the search is never silently missing: when it is off or has no address, the assistant says so, and the log has a line "chat: web search …" for every question (offered, off, no address, locked). Asking in so many words ("such im Internet", "google mal", "recherchier", "schau online nach", "search the web") always goes through the search. After reading a mail the search stays locked for the rest of that answer (a mail could otherwise carry its content to the web). Since V01.0.194 an answer from mail (also a mail note the assistant made by itself) stays in the next turn only when the new question is about it ("what else does she write?", "read the first one"); t

head: Voice chat
title: Wake word "Hey Spark"
text: Wake word "Hey Spark": with the checkbox below the chat the assistant keeps listening. Say "Hey Spark" and it listens; "Hey Spark, what's the weather?" in one go is taken as the question. The browser detects speech bursts, the speech recognition on the Spark checks for the phrase, nothing goes to the internet. The screen stays on; on a phone keep the app in the foreground.

head: Voice chat
title: The "Me" window
text: The "Me" window: since V01.0.125 in the same groups as the Features page (conversation, my data, my day, mail and contacts, home, on the go and devices, access); on a computer it starts with an *Overview* (the state of each page, e.g. "2 calendars connected"), on a phone the state sits right below each entry of the list. Notifications and the daily briefing have their own page *Notifications*. the button with your name (or "Guest") at the top of the history and the settings icon below the face open the same window. On the left is a short list: Conversation and, logged in, Memory, Log and Security, plus, depending on the features switched on, Documents, Calendar, E-mail, Smart home, Voice, Von selbst (speaking up by itself) and Raum-Modus (room mode); as a guest it shows "Sign in". Conversation holds listening (stop on silence, live transcript, barge-in and its sensitivity), answer (voice, profiles only; speaking rate, answer length) and display. Guests always hear the default voice. Logged in, the settings live in the profile on the Spark and apply on every device, including speakers with a device key; as a guest only in the browser. "Hey Spark" is set per device because it keeps t

head: Voice chat
title: The "Me" window
text: he microphone and screen awake. Defaults for guests and new profiles are under Settings → Defaults. The speaking rate keeps the pitch; it also works for other apps that send speed to the TTS API (vllm-omni backend).

head: Voice chat
title: Own documents
text: Own documents: logged-in profiles upload their own files in the "Me" window (PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OpenDocument, text, Markdown, HTML, CSV, e-mail as .eml; up to 20 MB each, at most 200 per profile). When asked about them, the assistant searches them and names the document with its page below the answer. Guests cannot upload anything, and no profile sees another's documents. Can be turned off under Features.

Under Me → Documents "View" shows a document's stored text with its pages (and a kept original: pictures and PDFs in the browser, everything else only as a download), every document has a switch "the assistant searches it", "Try the search" shows the hits without the language model, and the sources below an answer can be clicked. Three switches below "Own documents", each off by default, the admin under Features and the profile under Me → Documents (admin defaults never switch them on, never guests): - *Read pictures and scans:* photos (JPEG, PNG, WebP) and PDF pages without text (the page's biggest picture) are cleaned like chat pictures (format check, at most 40 megapixels, upright, 1600 pixels

head: Voice chat
title: Document status (V01.0.228)
text: Document status (V01.0.228): under Status → Monitoring the card “Own documents” appears once the admin switches on “Read pictures and scans” or “Meaning search” (GET /api/admin/wissen, admin login only). It shows the meaning model's state (off, starting, running with its memory in MiB, waiting for 8.5 GiB free memory, error with reason), how many pieces already have a meaning vector, how many pages still wait to be read, how many were read today and when last. head: Voice chat
title: Progress (V01.0.232)
text: Progress (V01.0.232): under Me → Documents every document still being read shows "page 3 of 12 read" with a bar and why it is not moving right now: "reading page 4 now", "waits for a quiet minute" (someone talks to the assistant), "daily limit reached, continues tomorrow" or "Read pictures and scans is off". With meaning search it then shows "meaning 40 of 120" (and whether the model waits for free memory). While something runs and the list is open, it refreshes every 10 seconds. Everyone sees only their own documents. The iPhone app shows "page x of y read".

head: Voice chat
title: Shared documents (V01.0.236)
text: Shared documents (V01.0.236): with the admin switch *Features → Own documents → Shared documents* and the profile switch *Me → Documents → Gemeinsame Dokumente* (both off by default) every finished document gets "For everyone". A ticked document stays in its owner's database and is not read again; every other profile with the switch on finds it in its search (source "…, geteilt von name") and sees it under "Shared for everyone by others" with "View". Only the owner takes the sharing back, changes or deletes the document; the admin sees under Status → Monitoring what is shared and can take it back. Guests, Telegram without "personal" and voices a shared speaker does not recognize as its owner get no shared documents. Their text stays outside text like any document. Agents still search only their own documents.

head: Voice chat
title: Complete scans and reading again (V01.0.238)
text: Complete scans and reading again (V01.0.238): scanned PDF pages (less than 40 characters of text) are rendered as whole pages with pypdfium2 (fixed version 4.30.0, about 30 MB of memory for a moment per page) and handed to the language model. Up to V01.0.236 the Spark only took the biggest embedded picture; scanners storing a page as strips or JBIG2 lost pages that way. Up to 300 scanned pages per document are read (30 before), still at most 100 per profile and day; the rest follows on the next days, up to 600 pages may wait per profile. The document names any limit that applies ("only the first 300 of 412 pages without text", "2 pages without a readable picture skipped", "pages without text not read (Read pictures and scans is off)"). "Read again" under Me → Documents reads a document once more from its kept original (owner only, only with "Keep originals"); place, "For everyone" and "The assistant searches it" stay. A document attached to a question in the iPhone app still takes along only its first 20,000 characters; the answer then says it is only the beginning and that under "My documents" the whole text is searched.

head: Voice chat
title: Read long documents at night (V01.0.240)
text: Read long documents at night (V01.0.240): admin switch under *Features → Own documents → Read pictures and scans* (chat.doc_night, off) with a night window (doc_night_from/doc_night_to, default 01:00 to 06:00, may cross midnight). By day the Spark reads in quiet moments only documents with at most 10 waiting pages; longer ones only after 30 minutes without a question, or in the night window. At night pages are counted apart, up to 400 per profile and night on top of the daily limit of 100. Speech still comes first (vorrang.py). Me → Documents names the reason: "long document, read at night from 01:00" or "daily limit reached, continues at night from 01:00".

head: Voice chat
title: Size and space (V01.0.242)
text: Size and space (V01.0.242): PDFs may be up to 100 MB; the admin sets 20 to 300 MB under *Features → Own documents → Largest PDF file* (chat.doc_max_mb); all other kinds of files stay at 20 MB. Uploads that are too big are refused before they are read; the page says so before uploading. The "space per profile" (chat.doc_quota_mb, default 500 MB) now counts all uploads of a profile together (database with text, meaning vectors and waiting pages plus originals). When it is full, the Spark takes nothing new; originals are kept only while there is room. Me → Documents shows "Used: 120 MB of 500 MB" with a bar. Under Status → Monitoring the admin sees per profile how much is used and gives single profiles their own value (50 to 50,000 MB, state/doc-quotas.json, in the backup).

text: ew, Apple's viewer for Word, PowerPoint, Excel and PDF and "Share" (save to Files, send on). Looks: without an own template the Spark builds presentations with a title slide, an overview slide (from 4 parts), numbered boxes, key-number cards (stats, up to 4), a quote box (quote), styled tables and charts; Word and PDF get a colored title block, numbered headings with a line, cards, quote box, zebra tables and page numbers; Excel a title band without gridlines, a colored head row, zebra rows, a set-off total row and a chart with values. New looks "Frisch" (fresh) and "Warm"; "Spark dark" prints light in Word, PDF and Excel. With an own template everything stays as before.

head: Voice chat
title: Professional presentations (since V01.0.465)
text: Professional presentations (since V01.0.465): For slides the language model picks one of ten types per slide and fills only its fields: section divider, key statement (one big sentence), icon grid (3 to 6 points with a symbol), big numbers, timeline or process, comparison in two columns, picture and text, chart with a message, conclusion and bullet points. Fixed rules in the Spark (folien.py) keep the variety: never the same type twice in a row, at most a third lists. A slide has at most 4 points of at most 8 words; the heading is a statement. When a part is too long the Spark asks the model once more, after that it shortens at a natural break and puts the full text into the speaker notes. Charts only with at least 3 different values that all have a source; the source stands below and the key value is highlighted, otherwise they become big numbers. The symbols (161 from Lucide, ISC license) are part of the repository. With the switch *Pictures from the Kiwix* (admin and profile, off) the Spark fetches a picture for the title slide and "picture and text" slides from the Wikipedia in the own Kiwix, checks it and saves it anew (at most 3 MB), with source and license note on the slide.

head: Voice chat
title: Professional presentations (since V01.0.465)
text: Before writing the Spark looks the title up in your Kiwix and your documents; every number in the text must be there, in your words or in the facts of the conversation, otherwise it is left out (small counts up to 10 without a unit excepted). The ready note says how much was left out. Word and PDF show icons, timeline and comparison as blocks of their own, Markdown and own templates as bullet points. Everything works without the internet.

head: Voice chat
title: Picture recognition (V01.0.190, off by default)
text: Picture recognition (V01.0.190, off by default): a profile attaches a photo in the assistant (picture button next to the text field, paste or drop; up to three per question) and asks about it, typed or spoken. qwen38's language model (Qwen3.8 can see pictures) looks at it itself. Switches: the admin under Features → Picture recognition, where "Check picture recognition" sends a test picture to see whether the running lane accepts pictures; each profile under Me → Conversation → "Pictures to the assistant", for the iPhone app also "Let the model look at photos from the app", for Telegram "Photos over Telegram" (caption = question, reply to the photo = follow-up). Never guests, speakers or other device keys. The browser makes the picture smaller; the Spark reads it again (Pillow, at most 8 MB and 40 megapixels, JPEG/PNG/WebP only, with a time limit), turns it upright, scales it to 1280 pixels and writes it again as JPEG, so location (GPS) and camera data are gone. It is kept in memory only, bound to profile and device, 10 minutes after the last question (30 minutes at most, 3 per profile, 30 per hour), never on disk, in the backup or the log, unless the person keeps it with "Picture

head: Voice chat
title: Picture recognition (V01.0.190, off by default)
text: to My documents" (see knowledge from uploads). In an answer with a picture the model gets no tools; the answer counts as outside text, the next turn is locked like after a web page, and nothing is learned from it. Below the answer, "Store under My documents" keeps the answer text. API: POST /api/chat/image (raw picture) → {"id"}, then POST /api/chat with "images": [id]; GET /api/chat/image says whether the caller may.

head: Voice chat
title: Messages in the conversation
text: Messages in the conversation: hovering over a message (on a phone: tapping it) shows a bin and, on answers, a speaker. The bin deletes the message, a question together with its answer. The speaker reads the answer out again.

head: Voice chat
title: Timers and reminders
text: Timers and reminders: "remind me about the oven in 10 minutes" or "remind me tomorrow at 8 about the appointment". Pending reminders show as small chips below the toggles (✕ cancels); "which timers are running?" and "cancel the oven timer" work by voice too. When one is due, the page chimes, shows it in the conversation and speaks it; if the tab is in the background, a browser notification appears as well. This works while the page is open. Profiles keep their reminders on the Spark, guests only in their own browser. Since V01.0.176 a profile's reminder rings only once: the first device that plays it (an open page, the iPhone app or push) takes it on the Spark, all others stay silent. While a page of the profile is open, push waits 20 seconds so the reminder does not ring there and arrive as a notification too. A reminder that was more than 10 minutes overdue when the page opens shows quietly in the conversation ("Missed"). The iPhone app without Apple push rings with its own alarms; if it is closed then, it reports that the next time it opens. At the same moment as an open page it can then still ring twice; with Apple push it does not. Can be turned off under Features.

head: Voice chat
title: Reminders as notifications
text: Reminders as notifications (profiles only): in the "Me" window under "Conversation", "Reminders on this device → Switch on" turns on push notifications. A reminder then arrives also when the page is closed, and only on the devices of that profile. This needs https with a valid certificate (e.g. behind a reverse proxy); on an iPhone first add the page to the home screen ("Share → Add to Home Screen"). The Spark only sends to the browsers' push services (Apple, Google, Mozilla, Microsoft), encrypted. Since V01.0.181 every notification (reminder, "speaking up" note, morning briefing, agent report) arrives once: on the device the profile used last (an open page, the iPhone app or Telegram, at most 12 hours back), else the iPhone app, else Telegram, else the browser set up last. Private notes go over Telegram only when the profile allowed personal data there.

head: Voice chat
title: Daily briefing as a notification
text: Daily briefing as a notification (profiles only): below that, each profile sets a time under "Tagesbriefing als Mitteilung" (daily briefing as notification). Every morning at that time a short briefing (appointments, reminders, unread mail, your topics) then goes to all devices of the profile with notifications on, and it is also kept in the history. "Aus" (off) turns it off.

head: Voice chat
title: Daily briefing and calendar
text: Daily briefing and calendar: say "good morning" or "what's on today?" and the assistant reads out today's and tomorrow's appointments, today's reminders and a few lines on your own topics (e.g. "weather Berlin", via your SearXNG). "What do I have on Friday?" works too. Each profile connects one or more calendars (up to 8) in the "Me" window, tab Calendar; an appointment found in two calendars is read out once. Each one is a CalDAV address with user and app password (iCloud: https://caldav.icloud.com with the Apple ID and an app-specific password from appleid.apple.com; Nextcloud: …/remote.php/dav; Radicale …), or a subscription link with webcal://, webcals:// or https:// (Google: "secret address in iCal format", a public iCloud calendar). New appointments: "put dentist on Tuesday 10 am in my calendar" makes the assistant read out a proposal; only when you answer with a plain yes in the same conversation does the panel itself write it to the first CalDAV calendar (optionally with an alarm). Subscription links stay read only. The password stays on the Spark and is never shown again. Guests get no calendar. Can be turned off under Features.

head: Voice chat
title: Reading e-mail
text: Reading e-mail: "Any new mail?", "What does Anna write?", "Read me the mail from the bank". Each profile connects up to 4 mailboxes over IMAP in the "Me" window, tab E-mail: iCloud (imap.mail.me.com, your iCloud mail address and a new app-specific password from appleid.apple.com), Gmail (imap.gmail.com, app password, needs 2-step verification), GMX and web.de (allow IMAP in their settings first) or any other IMAP server with TLS. Outlook/Microsoft 365 is not supported yet (needs OAuth). The assistant only reads the inbox of the last 30 days and changes nothing: the mailbox is opened read only, no mail is sent, deleted, moved or marked as read. It summarizes mails and reads them out word for word only when asked; the daily briefing names the unread ones. Mail text is treated as someone else's words: once the assistant read a mail in an answer, in that answer it cannot switch smart home devices, change memory, cancel reminders, search the web or enter appointments, so a crafted mail cannot trigger anything; answers made from mails are not learned into memory. Guests and another person's voice at a different device get no access. The password is stored encrypted on the Spark and never

head: Voice chat
title: Reading e-mail
text: shown again. Mail times are given in your time zone (else the Spark's), not with the sender's offset (V01.0.466). Off until turned on under Features.

head: Voice chat
title: Inbox tidying
text: Inbox tidying (Features → "Postfach aufräumen", off by default; needs reading e-mail; profiles only): the Spark sorts advertising, newsletters, invoices, notifications and social media mail into folders under a main folder (Spark/ unless renamed, e.g. Spark/Werbung; renamed in the "Me" window under E-mail, empty puts the folders at the top. Renaming also renames them in the mailbox with IMAP RENAME, the mail moves along; if the new name exists already, the old folder stays) so the inbox keeps only what matters. It only moves; it never deletes, never sends and never marks mail as read. When the server has no IMAP MOVE (iCloud), it copies the mail into the target folder, checks that the copy arrived, and only then removes exactly that original from the inbox (UIDPLUS); no other mail is touched. Each profile picks per mailbox in the "Me" window, tab E-mail, part "Inbox tidying": off, preview (only shows what it would move; a week is recommended to start), safe automatic (moves only what a rule or clear headers such as List-Unsubscribe prove) or fully automatic (also when the model is at least 85 % sure). Only new mail is checked, every 5, 15 (default) or 60 minutes. Who decides, in th

head: Voice chat
title: Inbox tidying
text: is order: people you wrote to (sent folder), sign-in and security mails and your "always keep" list stay put; then your rules (sender or @domain); then fixed headers; only then the language model, which may only return a category from the fixed list and has no tools. It asks first for invoices and notifications and for unclear mail; your answer can become a rule. Move a mail back into the inbox and it is not moved again, and the Spark asks. Brakes: at most 200 mails per run, and a run that would move more than half of at least 10 new mails stops and puts everything into the preview. Every move stays in the history for 30 days and can be undone. "Old mail" proposes once where the last 90 days belong; nothing moves until you press "Move". By voice: "Tidy my inbox", "Move everything from Lidl to advertising", "Undo that"; the assistant reads out a proposal and the panel carries it out only after your plain "yes". Reply drafts (per mailbox): "Write Anna that I'm coming" saves a draft in the drafts folder after your "yes"; you send it yourself in your mail app. Guests and other people's voices get no access.

head: Voice chat
title: Writing help (V01.0.332, `schreib.py`)
text: Writing help (V01.0.332, schreib.py): improve mails and other texts (also from Word, Excel, Pages). Switches: Features → Mail and contacts → "Schreibhilfe" (admin, off) and Me → Writing help → "Use the writing help for me" (profile, off); never guests. On the page Me → Writing help: paste a text, pick what to do (Correct: only spelling, grammar, punctuation; Smooth; Shorter; Friendlier; More formal; Translate into German, English, French, Spanish, Italian or Dutch; Draft a reply from the mail you received and your own notes, missing details come as [square brackets]), optionally a free wish about the form ("informal", sign-off). When correcting, smoothing, shortening and rephrasing the panel shows every change in colour; the panel works out the changes itself (word comparison), not the model. "Copy", "Use as my text" (for a second round). With "Picture recognition", "Read from picture" or a screenshot pasted with Ctrl+V reads the text from a picture (the picture is dropped right after). With "Reading e-mail", "Inbox tidying" and the mailbox switch "Drafts", "Put into the mailbox as a draft" saves the text in the drafts folder; nothing is ever sent. For other programs there is the M

head: Voice chat
title: Writing help (V01.0.332, `schreib.py`)
text: CP tool write_text ("Improve text") under Me → Services over MCP. The text is data only: a single call of the language model without tools, between fixed marks, told never to follow requests in the text. Nothing is stored (no history, no memory); the journal, Logs → Requests and Status → Live see only the kind, the number of characters and the time. Limits: 20,000 characters of text and mail, 96 KB per request, one request per profile at a time, two on the whole Spark, 20 per minute. Notaus stage 3 stops the writing help, from stage 2 there are no drafts. Plan: plaene/schreibhilfe.md.

head: Voice chat
title: Writing help in other programs (V01.0.339)
text: Writing help in other programs (V01.0.339): sub-switches Features → Schreibhilfe → "In other programs" (admin, off) and Me → Writing help → "Use in other programs" (profile, off). Then Me → Writing help shows the programs to download and "Pair a program": one click (with confirmation code) gives a setup line like https://spark.example.de#schreib=ABCD-EFGH, valid 10 minutes, usable once. The program swaps it for its own device key of kind "write" that can only improve texts (no chat, no mail, no drafts, no history). Paired programs are listed below and can be removed one by one; at most 10 per profile. - Mac (download "Mac quick action"): Services menu "Mit Spark verbessern" in Apple Mail, Pages, Word, Excel and any other program, optionally with a shortcut. Pick what to do, look at the suggestion, "Übernehmen" replaces the selection. Key in the keychain. - Windows (x64 and ARM): since V01.0.342 part of the Spark companion (below), paired under Me → Companion. - Outlook, Word, Excel (Office add-in, only with the Spark's https address): download the manifest and load it in Outlook under "Get Add-ins" → "My add-ins" → "Custom add-in", or in Word/Excel as a shared add-in. Side pane wit

head: Voice chat
title: Writing help in other programs (V01.0.339)
text: h kind, suggestion and "Übernehmen" into the mail, document or cell. Works in Outlook for Windows, Mac and the web. - Browser (extension for Chrome, Edge, Firefox): right-click selected text in webmailers (Outlook on the web, Gmail, GMX, web.de and others) → "Mit Spark verbessern". Load as unpacked extension; in Firefox only until restart. - iPhone and iPad (Spark app): Share → Spark → "Improve text" and the shortcut "Improve text with Spark"; uses the app key. All programs send only the selected text, the Spark does not store it; http only in the home network. Live and logs show program kind, kind and number of characters.

head: Voice chat
title: Spark companion on PC and Mac (V01.0.342, `begleiter.py`, `tools/begleiter`)
text: Spark companion on PC and Mac (V01.0.342, begleiter.py, tools/begleiter): a small program in the Windows taskbar (x64 and ARM, GitHub Action "Spark-Begleiter Windows", release begleiter-windows) and the Mac menu bar (macOS 13 and later, Action "Spark-Begleiter Mac", release begleiter-mac). Switches: Features → On the go and devices → "Spark companion on PC and Mac" (admin, off) and Me → Companion → "Spark companion for me" (profile, off); never guests. Pairing: Me → Companion → "Pair a device" gives a setup line …#begleiter=ABCD-EFGH (10 minutes, once, with confirmation code); the program gets its own key of kind "desk" that knows only its own paths. Parts, on or off per device under Me → Companion (new devices: writing help, Ask Spark, notes and state on; dictation and the kill-switch button off): - Writing help (needs the writing help itself): select text, Ctrl+Alt+S (Mac ⌥⌘S or the Services menu). Defaults per device: kind, language for translating, fixed wish, which kinds show in the menu, show the suggestion first or replace at once. - Ask Spark: Ctrl+Alt+A (⌥⌘A) opens a window for a question, the answer comes as text; follow-ups within 10 minutes keep the context, a day's que

head: Voice chat
title: Spark companion on PC and Mac (V01.0.342, `begleiter.py`, `tools/begleiter`)
text: stions are a conversation "Begleiter" in the history. - Dictation: Ctrl+Alt+D (⌥⌘D) starts and ends the recording (at most 60 seconds, visible indicator), the recognised text lands at the cursor. Language per device. - Notes: the Spark's notes as system notifications when the companion is the device used last (like the Android app, the program fetches them every 30 seconds). - State dot: icon normal, grey (Spark not reachable) or red (Notaus or my kill switch). - My kill switch: menu item with a confirmation, stops the own profile (as Me → Security). Lifting only in the browser with the PIN. Hotkeys are set in the program under Settings. Changes in the panel reach the program with its next check. Removing a device under Me → Companion stops its key at once. Windows: not signed, SmartScreen on first start ("More info" → "Run anyway"), key encrypted with DPAPI. Mac: not notarized yet, first start right-click → Open; for the writing-help hotkey and pasting macOS asks once for "Accessibility", for dictation for the microphone; key in the keychain. Status → Live shows pairing, questions, dictations (character count only) and notes to "Spark-Begleiter".

head: Voice chat
title: Companion: updates, look, coffee (V01.0.347)
text: Companion: updates, look, coffee (V01.0.347): The programs now look like the panel: the Spark face as icon in taskbar and menu bar (dot bottom right: green reachable, grey not reachable, red kill switch, accent colour when a new version is there), a window on clicking the icon with all parts that are on and their hotkeys, light and dark look following the system. Updates: the Spark fetches new versions itself from the GitHub releases begleiter-windows and begleiter-mac (once a day and only when a device of that kind is paired; Features → Spark companion → "Fetch new version now" at once) and checks size and SHA-256 against the version's begleiter.json. The program learns from its check that a new version is there, downloads it only from the paired Spark, checks size and SHA-256 again and installs only after your click on "Update"; a damaged file is deleted and the old version keeps running. Settings → About shows the version, "Check for updates" and the switch "Download updates automatically, ask before installing". The first version with updates has to be installed by hand once. The program and Me → Companion carry the link "☕ Support Spark" (buymeacoffee.com).

head: Voice chat
title: Companion deeper in the computer (V01.0.353)
text: Companion deeper in the computer (V01.0.353): eight more parts, all off, turned on per device under Me → Companion: - Right-click on files: "With Spark" in Explorer (Windows 11: "Show more options") and under Services in Finder: summarize, translate, explain (PDF, Office, text, mail, pictures; at most 20 MB, the first 40,000 characters are read) or add to knowledge (needs own documents). - Ask about the screen: Ctrl+Alt+B (⌥⌘B), drag a region, optionally a question, then explain, read out the text or translate. The language model reads the picture; it is kept nowhere. - Know the app: the writing help learns the kind of program (mail, Word, Excel, chat, browser …) and fits tone and form; program names and window titles do not go to the Spark. - Draft a reply: Ctrl+Alt+M (⌥⌘M) for the open mail in Outlook (classic, Windows) or Apple Mail: the answer is a draft in the reply window; nothing is ever sent. In the new Outlook it is on the clipboard. - Spark-Wissen folder: what lands in the folder (default: Spark-Wissen in the user folder) goes into the own documents; a changed file replaces its older version, at most 50 a day. - Buttons in notes: Reply, Later, Open panel. A reply goes to

head: Voice chat
title: Companion deeper in the computer (V01.0.353)
text: the Spark with the note as context; the note counts as outside text (nothing switches). - Act on the PC (own admin switch "May act on the PC", off): for a request like "Open tagesschau.de on the PC" the computer asks in a window whether it may (60 s, else no). Allowed only: open a page (http/https), a program released under Me → Companion, music (play, pause, next, previous), volume, lock the screen, show a text. Locked after mail, web pages or other outside text. - Wake word on the PC: "Hey Spark" through the computer's microphone, as in the browser (short pieces to speech recognition, a hit starts the question). Listens only while the part is on; the icon shows it, "Pause wake word" in the window.

head: Voice chat
title: Companion: seven more parts (V01.0.375)
text: Companion: seven more parts (V01.0.375): all off, turned on per device under Me → Companion. Read aloud (Ctrl+Alt+L, ⌥⌘L): marked text in your Spark voice, at most 5000 characters. From the phone to the PC: text (into the clipboard), a link (opened only after asking, only http/https) or a file (at most 20 MB, into "Downloads/Vom Spark") from the panel ("Send to the PC" at the device) or by voice ("Send the link to my PC"); waits up to 24 hours. Appointments in the companion: the next 24 hours with a note 10 minutes before, "Remind me in 20 min" on notes. Recognise do not disturb: while another program uses the microphone or camera or a presentation runs, notes and announcements on your own speakers wait; a summary "Während du beschäftigt warst" follows. Notaus, security notes and reminders always come. Write along in meetings (own admin switch "Write along in meetings", off): only on a click, with a red bar; the microphone and the computer's sound go to speech recognition, the transcript stays in memory only (at most 3 hours). Afterwards a summary and tasks; chosen tasks become reminders, the summary on request a document on the reMarkable, and it is in the history. Everybody takin

head: Voice chat
title: Companion: seven more parts (V01.0.375)
text: g part must agree. Smart home buttons: up to 12 buttons (lights, switches, fans, climate, scenes) of your Home Assistant, set up under Me → Companion; with a code word the companion asks for it. Start and end of the day: in the morning the daily overview, in the evening tomorrow's appointments and what is open. For "Act on the PC" the companion sends the list of installed programs; under Me → Companion you pick from it instead of typing name and path.

head: Voice chat
title: Companion update looks right away (V01.0.377)
text: Companion update looks right away (V01.0.377): "Check for updates" in the program and every program start make the Spark look at GitHub at once (at most every 5 minutes per kind of computer); before, it looked once a day. The Mac names the failing step when it refuses an update.

head: Voice chat
title: Companion with the chosen face (V01.0.395)
text: Companion with the chosen face (V01.0.395): the companion shows the face picked under Settings → Defaults (robot or comic) in every window and the icon; a change arrives with the next check. In the companion the comic face is a still picture.

head: Voice chat
title: Acting on the PC right at the companion (V01.0.397)
text: Acting on the PC right at the companion (V01.0.397): asked in Ask Spark on the computer itself ("open Safari with Google"), the computer need not be named; a verb of doing (open, start, play, louder, quieter, lock, show) is enough. The question at the computer stays.

head: Voice chat
title: Acting on the PC from a speaker or the phone (V01.0.419)
text: Acting on the PC from a speaker or the phone (V01.0.419): a clear order naming the computer ("Open heise.de on my Mac") is now reliably sent to the computer from there too; the question still comes at the computer. When it cannot go (no computer paired, "Act on the PC" off at the device or for the profile), the Spark says exactly that instead of trying other tools. Speech recognition may write "Mac" as "Mäc".

head: Voice chat
title: Office add-ins from the companion (V01.0.433)
text: Office add-ins from the companion (V01.0.433): new part "Office add-ins" (per device, off; needs the writing help). Then "Office-Add-ins einrichten …" in the companion; it asks first. Outlook classic (Windows): a "Spark" button in the ribbon (main window and reading: draft a reply, translate; composing: improve text, translate), also with iCloud or IMAP accounts. The button only sends one fixed word to the running companion, which works as with its hotkeys; nothing is ever sent. Word and Excel (Windows and Mac): the companion registers the Office add-in itself. For that open the panel once at its https address, save under Me → Companion and turn on "In other programs" of the writing help. New Outlook, Outlook for Mac and on the web: the companion shows the file and opens the page "Add from file"; adding it is done by the person (Microsoft allows nothing else, only for Microsoft 365, Exchange or Outlook.com). Part off: everything is removed again.

head: Voice chat
title: Speaking into the companion windows (V01.0.466)
text: Speaking into the companion windows (V01.0.466): with the part "Dictation" on, every free text field in the companion windows has a mic button: "Draft a reply" (notes and mail text), "Improve text" (wish, source text, result), "Ask about the screen" (question) and, as before, "Ask Spark". First click starts, the second (■) stops the recording (at most 60 seconds); the Spark recognizes the text, it goes to the cursor or the end and is never run. So the Outlook classic buttons "Draft a reply" and "Improve text" can be used by voice too. Never in code word or password fields. The Office add-ins in Word, Excel and new Outlook have no mic button. Button labels never break inside a word; if the Mac panel is too narrow, "Spark unterstützen" moves to its own line.

head: Voice chat
title: Room mode
text: Room mode (Features → "Raum-Modus", off by default; profiles only): the switch "Raum" below the face lets the assistant listen to the conversation in the room at this device for a chosen time (15 minutes to 4 hours, it ends by itself); an orange dot shows it. In a pause it helps when a fixed cue came up: an open question (with web search, nothing when in doubt), an appointment ("Shall I enter it?"), "cold", "too warm" or "too dark" (the room's real temperature from Home Assistant, offering to change the heating by one degree or switch on the light) and things to buy (Home Assistant shopping list). It changes something only after a "yes", for the smart home with the code word when one is set. In the "Me" window under "Room mode" each device sets the duration, how much it may say (questions only, also hints, also comments), each kind on its own, the device's room in Home Assistant and "text only" (silently in the conversation instead of spoken). What it hears stays in the panel's memory for five minutes and is never stored; room mode uses neither memory, mail nor earlier conversations. Everyone in the room should know it is listening. Since V01.0.95 it also offers a timer ("The pizza

head: Voice chat
title: Room mode
text: needs 12 more minutes") and a reminder ("I must not forget to call grandma"), both only after a "yes", and calculates unit questions ("How much is 180 degrees in Fahrenheit?"). A question that points back ("When did he die?") is completed from the last sentences, only with words that were said. With a taught voice and speaker identification on, only the profile's own voice can say "yes". A soft tone comes before it speaks; "Stopp" ends the sentence, "Nicht jetzt" keeps it quiet for 15 minutes, "Raummodus aus" (also "Hör auf zuzuhören") switches it off, from any voice. Since V01.0.126 the profile's quiet hours apply (Me → Proactive, 22 to 7 by default): then everything appears as text only, never spoken. When the page is in the background or the phone locked for more than two minutes (the microphone hears nothing there anyway), room mode ends with its summary; closing the tab ends it at once. Since V01.0.128 it also runs on the own ESP32 speakers, all board variants: "Raummodus an" after the wake word or the switch "Room" under Me → Speakers (when the speaker sleeps, it starts at its next wake word), where duration, how much it may say and the room in Home Assistant are set per spe

head: Voice chat
title: Room mode
text: aker. The Spark keeps the connection open, cuts out every sentence, runs it through speech recognition and speaks in a pause after the soft tone; boards with a display show the sentence. It ends after its time, with "Raummodus aus", the switch, when the connection drops or when the admin or the profile switch it off; then the board waits for its wake word again. In quiet hours the speaker stays silent. Since V01.0.140 the speaker cuts long stretches of talk after at most 8 seconds and checks every sentence on its own, speaks after 1.5 seconds of quiet (counted from the last loud sound, not from the end of a piece), streams the speech, and each speaker has "detect more". Questions are now recognized without a question mark from the speech recognition ("Wie hoch ist die Zugspitze"), after "Sag mal" or "Weißt du, wann …" and with "Stimmt es, dass …"; questions about the people in the room ("Wo ist meine Brille") stay out. The answer is looked up while people still talk and is ready in the pause (in the browser too). "Also comments" is chattier: at most every two minutes, after three seconds of quiet, one casual sentence about the conversation. Since V01.0.142 Me → Speakers has "Stimme

head: Voice chat
title: Room mode
text: hier anlernen" (speaker identification on, browser login, with the second step when set up): the speaker asks for three sentences and keeps its own voiceprint for its microphone; a sentence counts for a profile when it fits any of its voiceprints (browser or speaker). Until somebody taught a voice through a speaker, it listens to everybody despite "only known voices" (log: "listens to everybody (no voice taught through it yet)"), because a voice taught in the browser is rarely recognized through the small board microphone. At most two speakers at once, because speech recognition runs all the time. While it speaks, the wake word interrupts it. Option "Genauer erkennen": the model looks for missed questions, appointments and shopping, counted only with a word-for-word quote. When room mode ends, the page shows what it said and did (not what it heard), not stored. Every decision writes a "room:" line to the log (why it spoke or stayed silent, never the heard text).

head: Voice chat
title: Ignoring TV voices
text: Ignoring TV voices (since V01.0.139; Features → Room mode → "Fernsehstimmen überhören", off by default): every device picks under Me → Room mode "Who it listens to" (speakers under Me → Speakers): *everybody* (as before, default), *only known voices while the TV is on* (recommended) or *always only known voices*. A voice is known when a profile taught it under Me → Speaker identification; speaker identification must be on. It then runs for every sentence in room mode, on the CPU next to speech recognition (about 0.1 s per sentence), with no extra GPU load. Whether the TV is on comes from Home Assistant at most every 30 seconds: a media player on, playing or buffering in the device's room, without a room set anywhere in the home; when Home Assistant does not answer, it listens to everybody as before. A sentence in a foreign voice triggers no question or suggestion and is dropped at once; the model never sees it, not with "Genauer erkennen" or comments either. Always counted: a sentence starting with "Spark" (also from visitors), "Stopp", "Nicht jetzt" and "Raummodus aus". A "yes" still counts only in the profile's voice. Very short sentences (under about one second of speech) are of

title: Ignoring TV voices
text: ten not recognized and count as foreign. With *Trial* (on at first) nothing is ignored, only counted: at the end the summary and the log say "Probelauf: Von 40 Sätzen hätte ich 12 als fremde Stimme überhört.", for speakers also under *Check*. Only this number is kept, never the text or whose voice it was; the log says "room: ignored (unknown voice)" or "(unknown voice, tv on)".

head: Voice chat
title: Where it listens right now
text: Where it listens right now (since V01.0.208; part of room mode, no switch of its own): the Spark keeps a list of every device in room mode, browser pages and speakers, in memory only and only with name, kind, since/until, "who it listens to" and trial, never anything heard. A page signs in when switched on and gives a sign of life every minute; without one for three minutes (tab closed, phone locked) it drops out. After a restart it signs in again with its next sign of life. It shows (1) as a green strip on top of every page ("Kitchen listens until 21:30", View opens Me → Room mode), (2) at the face as "Also the kitchen is listening", (3) under Me → Room mode → *Active now* with *+30 min* and *Stop* (speakers waiting for their next wake word with *Do not start*), (4) for the admin under Status → *Listening right now* with profile, device and time, *Stop* and *Stop all*, and as a mark "listening" and the filter "listening right now" under People and devices. A page in room mode shows "● Room" in the tab title and a red dot on its icon. Everybody who sees the list may end a room (it only means less listening); extending only in the profile's browser login, never beyond 4 hours from n

head: Voice chat
title: Where it listens right now
text: ow. A browser's name is set under Me → Room mode → *Name of this device* (else e.g. "iPad · Safari", with a device key its name). *Reminder tone* (per device, speakers under Me → Speakers, off): the soft tone every 15 minutes, never in quiet hours. *Note when a speaker starts listening* (profile, off): when somebody says "Raummodus an" at your speaker, a note goes to the device used last, at most once an hour per speaker, never in quiet hours. *Recently*: the last 20 times within 14 days with device, time, how it ended and how many sentences were heard, said and ignored, never text (users/<profile>/room-history.json, in the backup). Home Assistant (admin: Features → Room mode → *Room mode for Home Assistant*, off): under Me → Room mode → Home Assistant the profile makes a key of its own (with the second step when set up; a new one replaces the old). It may only GET /api/room/active (count, first device, until when) and POST /api/room/end ({"all": true}), nothing else; the page shows the ready text for configuration.yaml once (REST sensor "Spark Raum-Modus", command spark_raummodus_aus). The log only says "room: listed …", "room: … ended (panel|iphone|ha|admin)" and "room: page … ga

head: Voice chat
title: Starting from afar
text: Starting from afar (since V01.0.213; admin: Features → Room mode → *Start room mode from afar* and profile: Me → Room mode → *Start room mode on another device*, both off): "Raummodus im Wohnzimmer an" (also "Kannst du den Raummodus für den Lautsprecher im Wohnzimmer aktivieren?", "… für 60 Minuten") in the panel, the iPhone app or at another speaker. The panel recognizes the sentence by fixed rules (roomfar.py); the language model gets no tools in that answer, Home Assistant is not asked and no code word is wanted. Only the profile's own speakers, found by name or by the room entered under Me → Speakers; when several fit, the answer names them. The speaker must be connected right now (it does not start later by itself; the switch "Room" is for that). Only a plain "Ja" in the next message of the same conversation (15 minutes) starts it; the speaker says "Raum-Modus an, gestartet von der iPhone-App" (or the panel, the kitchen speaker). Duration from the sentence (rounded to 15/30/60/120/240 minutes), else the speaker's own. Not via Telegram or Siri, never for guests or a voice recognized as someone else. "Raummodus im Wohnzimmer aus" / "Raummodus überall aus" ends without a question

head: Voice chat
title: Starting from afar
text: (history: "ended from another device"). With the switch off there is a fixed answer naming the switch. "Starte den Raummodus" without a place stays the device's own room mode. Log: "room: start at speaker … asked from …", "room: on at speaker … (remote from …)".

head: Voice chat
title: Speaking up by itself
text: Speaking up by itself (Features → "Von selbst melden", off by default; profiles only): each profile decides in the "Me" window under "Proactive" whether and why the assistant speaks unasked, each kind on its own: appointments ahead ("In 20 minutes: dentist. Shall I remind you again at 9:55?", a "yes" sets the reminder), its own smart home rules ("Whirlpool above 37.5", "bathroom window is open and rain is on", "washing machine power below 5 for 3 minutes"; read only, never switching), a short greeting with the next appointment or reminder when the conversation is opened after three hours or more, at most one follow-up a day on a plan mentioned yesterday, new mail from chosen senders (sender and subject only) and a weather note for tomorrow via web search. Plus quiet hours, a daily limit and learning from feedback: "nicht jetzt" means two hours of quiet, "das interessiert mich nicht" halves how often that kind may speak (can be reset). The panel decides when, by fixed rules from real data; where the model words something (follow-up, weather), its answer only counts when it quotes the data. With the conversation open the note is spoken, otherwise it arrives as a push notification. Si

head: Voice chat
title: Speaking up by itself
text: nce V01.0.179 only the first device of the profile says it (page or iPhone app), the others stay silent, just like reminders (V01.0.176). Every note is in the log with its reason. Since V01.0.385 the follow-up is a fixed sentence with the person's own words ("Gestern hast du zu mir gesagt: „…“. Hat das geklappt?"); the model only points at a sentence, and the panel takes it only when it is an own plan in the first person (no question, no request to the assistant, no pasted text, no question about a mail or web page, nothing from briefing, jobs or meetings). Asked about a note ("what do you mean?", "where is that from?"), the model gets its basis from the panel and must not make up another source; for mail notes only "sender and subject read", never mail text. Logs → Requests show it as "von selbst: Grundlage", Live shows a refused pick as an event.

head: Voice chat
title: Home Assistant tells the Spark
text: Home Assistant tells the Spark (since V01.0.314, plan plaene/home-assistant-meldungen.md): the smart home rules under "Proactive" can do more. Each rule can speak *at most every N minutes* (e.g. a motion sensor at most every 10 minutes), for "changes" *on*, *off* or both, and have an extra condition: *only when I am away* (the person in Home Assistant with your profile name or the one chosen under "Me in Home Assistant"), *only when nobody is home*, *only at night* or *only during the day* (by sun.sun, else 9 pm to 6 am). Plus five parts, each with its own admin switch under Features → Speaking up by itself and its own switch under Me → Proactive, all off at first, never for guests: *Instant notes from Home Assistant*: the Spark keeps a WebSocket connection to your Home Assistant (the same address and token, only the devices of your rules, subscribe_entities); a change arrives in about a second, also a motion sensor that triggers only briefly. If the connection drops, the Spark checks every minute again. *House notes on speakers*: a rule also says its own sentence on chosen speakers that take announcements from you, e.g. "Someone rang the bell."; only its own sentence without names

head: Voice chat
title: Home Assistant tells the Spark
text: , never for person devices and never with a camera picture, not in the speaker's quiet hours, at most 20 an hour. *Home Assistant tells the Spark*: a list of event names with a fixed sentence (e.g. klingel → "Es hat geklingelt.") and a key of its own; Home Assistant calls rest_command.spark_melden with event: klingel (POST /api/ha/event). Only names from the list count, nothing else from the request is read or said; at most 30 a minute, a pause per event (default 1 minute). *Smart home rule by voice*: "Sag mir Bescheid, wenn jemand an der Haustür ist", "Melde dich, wenn Anna heimkommt": the panel recognizes the sentence by fixed words, finds the device and asks "Soll ich mich melden, wenn …?"; only a "yes" in the same conversation adds the rule. *Describe a camera picture*: a rule can name a camera from Home Assistant; when it applies, the local language model describes the still in a few words. The picture is never stored, the description is outside text and goes to your devices only, at most 30 an hour. Log lines start with "hamelden:". Status → Live shows the live connection (under channels) and each note, event and described camera picture in fixed words, without device names,

head: Voice chat
title: Home Assistant tells the Spark
text: sentences or camera words. You don't have to type devices for a rule (since V01.0.317): the field suggests all devices from Home Assistant, "Zuletzt geändert" shows the last changed ones, and with "Gerät erkennen" you trigger the sensor within 40 seconds (motion, door, bell); whatever changes shows up to tap. The panel only compares the change time Home Assistant reports itself. Rules can be edited (since V01.0.319): "Edit" brings a rule back into the form, "Check and save" checks it like a new one and replaces it in the same place; it then starts fresh (speaks only after it was false once). Since V01.0.334 each fired rule and event shows on Status → Live as a request of "Home Assistant" (rule or event) with camera picture, note (Web Push, Apple Push, Android app, Telegram or the open page) and speaker announcement; everything else the Spark says by itself as a request of "Von selbst" (e.g. greeting, reminder, task). Never the sentence.

head: Voice chat
title: Natural turn-taking
text: Natural turn-taking (on by default, conversation settings): during a short pause the recording is transcribed already. A finished sentence ends the turn at once and its transcript becomes the question, so the answer starts noticeably sooner; after "and …", "because …", "um" or a comma the assistant waits up to 2 s for you to go on.

head: Voice chat
title: New conversation every day
text: New conversation every day (on by default, conversation settings → Display): the first question of a new day starts a new conversation; earlier ones stay in the history and can be picked and continued.

head: Voice chat
title: Speaker identification
text: Speaker identification (off by default, Features): each profile reads three short sentences in the "Me" window. When the assistant then clearly recognizes a voice, it answers for that profile, with its memory, documents, reminders and voice, even on a guest device. The conversation shows "🎙 name" below the question. When someone other than the logged-in profile speaks at a device, the assistant gets only that one question (not the device's conversation), and the exchange stays out of the logged-in profile's history and memory. When the voice is unclear, nothing changes. Recognition runs on the Spark's CPU (Resemblyzer model, Apache 2.0) and needs no GPU memory. Strictness is adjustable. A voice is not a password: someone who sounds very similar or plays a recording can get into a profile.

head: Voice chat
title: Profiles and memory
text: Profiles and memory: under People and devices the admin creates profiles with a name and PIN. In the chat you log in with the "Guest" button at the top of the conversation by typing name and PIN. Logged in, the assistant remembers things for good when you tell it to ("remember that I'm vegetarian") or when they will be useful later, and forgets them on request; the Me lists what it knows, for deleting. Memory and conversations belong to the profile and live on the Spark, so the same history shows on every device you are logged in on: which profile is asking is decided only by the login (cookie) or the device key, never by the model, and guests get no memory. Speakers and your own programs get a device key under People and devices that belongs to one profile, and send it as the header X-Speech-Device to /api/chat. A new PIN logs out every browser of that profile; deleting a profile removes its memory and devices. The data lives on the Spark under /var/lib/speech-spark/users, one folder per profile.

head: Voice chat
title: Home Assistant
text: Home Assistant (Funktionen → "Home Assistant", off by default): each profile connects its own Home Assistant in the "Me" window under "Smart home" with the address (e.g. http://homeassistant.local:8123) and a long-lived access token (Home Assistant: your profile → Security; best for a separate non-admin user). Then "turn on the living room light" or "how warm is it in the bathroom?" work in the conversation. Commands go to Home Assistant's own Assist (/api/conversation/process), so only entities exposed to Assist (Settings → Voice assistants → Expose) can be switched. Devices Assist does not know are switched directly through their service (e.g. switch.turn_on), except locks, alarm systems and updates. With a code word ("Me" window → Smart home) the assistant switches only when the code word is in the same message ("lights off, code word sunflower"); without it, it asks. The panel checks this itself, not the language model; the model and the stored conversations see only "[Codewort]", it is stored encrypted and compared with some tolerance for speech recognition (a letter or two off, "Apollo 13" = "Apollo dreizehn"). Questions need no code word. Also (ideas from ha-mcp): history ("

head: Voice chat
title: Home Assistant
text: how warm was it in the bathroom yesterday?"), several devices at once ("all lights in the living room off", each checked; an unknown room never switches the whole home), typo-tolerant device search and to-do lists such as the shopping list (read, add, tick off; changes need the code word). Questions about values, states, zones and where someone is are read directly (/api/states) instead: the assistant sees every device, sensor, zone and person the token's user may see, exposed or not. Home Assistant tells rooms (areas) only to an admin token; without admin rights devices are found by their names only. Only that profile can use its Home Assistant: guests never, and a voice recognized by speaker identification at someone else's device neither. The token is checked before saving, stays on the Spark (users/<id>/homeassistant.json, mode 0600) and is never sent back to the browser. When several devices fit a switching command, the device whose name, room or device class fits wins over one that only fits by its kind ("TV in the living room" is the TV there, not the Apple TV box next to it). If it stays unclear, the Spark switches nothing and names the fitting devices; the model then gets

head: Voice chat
title: Home Assistant
text: no switching tool (since V01.0.461).

head: Voice chat
title: Ask instead of guessing
text: Ask instead of guessing (Funktionen → "Rückfrage statt Raten", off by default; per profile under Me → Settings): when several devices fit a switching command, the Spark switches nothing at random but asks: "Several fit: Samsung, Samsung The Frame or TV. Which one do you mean?". In the chat the devices are buttons below it, plus "None of these". When it cannot find the device exactly it asks "I can't find that exactly. Do you mean …?"; "None of these" or "show all" brings the whole device list with a search field, grouped by room (never locks, alarm panels or remotes). The answer may be typed, spoken or tapped: name, room or number ("the second"). It only counts in the same conversation, on the same device and for two minutes; the code word of the command covers the choice but is never stored or spoken. When the Spark itself picked one of several devices, "No, the Apple TV" corrects it: the wrongly switched device goes back to its old state, the right one is switched. Fixed rules in the panel decide, never the language model. (since V01.0.470)

head: Voice chat
title: Remember the choice
text: Remember the choice (sub-switch, off by default): after a choice or a correction the Spark asks "Shall I remember that "TV in the living room" is Samsung?" (buttons "Yes, remember" and "No"). Only a yes stores it. From then on the same sentence switches that device at once; the code word is still needed. All mappings are under Me → Memory → "Mappings": change words, other target, delete, or assign your own from the device list with "Give own names". They live in the profile's zuordnungen.json and go with the memory into your own storage and the backup. The live page shows numbers only (open questions, asked today, chosen, corrected, remembered, used), the log fixed words only ("klaeren: frage ha 3 kandidaten"), never devices or sentences. (since V01.0.470)

head: Voice chat
title: Asking back for bus and train, weather and messages too
text: Asking back for bus and train, weather and messages too (same switch): "to the station" fits several stops and names none exactly, so the Spark asks with buttons instead of taking the first; the same for place names in different regions ("Karlsbad" in Germany and Czechia) in the weather and for lists in Home Assistant ("Einkauf" fits "Einkaufsliste" and "Einkauf Baumarkt"; for a change the code word of the request covers the choice). The choice runs the same request with the chosen target; after a yes the word stands for it from then on (Me → Mappings, areas "Bus and train", "Places (weather)" and "Lists"). With "Do you mean Quirin Meier or Quirin Müller?" the names are buttons below. In Telegram the choices come as a keyboard under the answer; a tap sends the name like a typed answer. In the apps and at a speaker the spoken or typed answer does it (name, room or number). A calendar named for an appointment that does not exist is never silently replaced by the first one any more: the Spark enters nothing and names the calendars there are. (since V01.0.470)

head: Voice chat
title: Searching conversations
text: Searching conversations: the magnifier next to the conversation list (on phones in the menu) searches all earlier conversations, a profile's with a profile, the browser's as a guest. A click opens the conversation at that spot.

head: Voice chat
title: Earlier conversations
text: Earlier conversations (Funktionen → "Frühere Gespräche", on by default; profiles only): the assistant can look up what you talked about before ("what did you tell me about the grill last week?", "what did we talk about yesterday?"), searching only your own profile's saved conversations. Conversations that have been quiet for ten minutes are also read once in the background, while nobody is talking, and up to three lasting facts per conversation go into the profile's memory, marked "automatic" in the "Me" window, where they can be deleted. Each profile can switch this learning off in the conversation settings ("Learn from conversations"). Once a week (or with "Propose cleanup") the assistant proposes merging duplicate entries and removing outdated ones; nothing changes until you accept the proposal under Me → Memory. With notifications on, a note is sent.

head: Voice chat
title: Pronunciation
text: Pronunciation: Settings → Speech output → Pronunciation takes one rule per line, e.g. DGX = De Ge Ix. It applies to whole words and to all speech output, Open WebUI included.

head: Voice chat
title: Barge-in
text: Barge-in: while the assistant speaks, the microphone keeps listening. Talking for about a quarter of a second interrupts the answer, and what you said becomes the next question. This relies on the browser's echo cancellation; if the assistant interrupts itself on loud speakers, use headphones or untick "barge in" below the chat.

head: Voice chat
title: Read answers aloud (since V01.0.409)
text: Read answers aloud (since V01.0.409): if you do not want speech output, switch it off. For one device, the "Vorlesen" switch below the face (on a phone the speaker icon at the top right of the chat) is enough; it applies to this browser or the Android app only. For all devices of the profile: conversation settings → answer → "Read answers aloud". The Spark then answers as text only, does not call the speech output at all (saves the GPU) and plays no instant acknowledgement either; notes, messages and reminders come with a chime and text but are not read aloud. Speakers without a screen and CarPlay keep speaking, there is nothing to read there. "Read again" on an answer still works. The Spark-Begleiter does not read "Frag Spark" answers aloud either while the profile switch is off.

head: Voice chat
title: Your own voice
text: Your own voice: under Voices you can record a reference straight from the microphone (read the suggested text, about 10 seconds); the panel fills in the transcript with the speech recognition. Cloning needs a Base model (Settings → Speech output → model …-Base), then pick the new voice as the default voice. The default voice is a list that fits the chosen model: CustomVoice shows the built-in speakers, Base your own voices, with VoiceDesign it is locked (the voice comes from the speaking style); a saved name missing from the list stays as "(not in the list)". A German reference gives much steadier German than the built-in speakers, which are not native German speakers. Under Voices, one or all of your own voices can be exported as a ZIP (reference audio and transcript) and imported again on this or another Spark; on a name clash the import renames, replaces or skips.

head: Voice chat
title: Required tools and answer check (V01.0.117)
text: Required tools and answer check (V01.0.117): questions about appointments, mail, reminders, timers, weather, parcels, transit, lists, match results and news have to go through the matching tool (one table NEED_TOOLS in chat.py, also used by the quality test). While the model chooses the tool, the "tool choice" temperature (0.1) applies, the normal one afterwards. The answer check (Settings → Language model, on by default) lets no sentence through for such questions that names a time, date, score or amount that is in no tool result, the question or the conversation so far; instead the assistant says once "Genauere Angaben dazu habe ich nicht." If the model answers without looking anything up, the answer is dropped and the model is asked once more. Both show up in the tool log as "Antwort-Prüfung". General questions without a tool are not checked. Optional: the admin allows "think while choosing tools", each profile switches it on under Me → Conversation (off, never guests). Since V01.0.404 a round with thinking holds its text until the thinking is over: when the server does not hand the thinking over apart (reasoning_content) but as text up to a lone </think> (Qwen gets the opening

head: Voice chat
title: Required tools and answer check (V01.0.117)
text: <think> in the prompt), everything before it is never shown, spoken or kept; a lone </think> is never shown (before, the answer came twice with </think> between). Since V01.0.455 no sentence of an answer comes twice: when the model writes the answer before a tool call (also one it only writes as text) and again after the result, the next round shows each sentence only once it is complete and leaves out sentences already said, in the chat and in the voice; Logs → Requests then show "Repetition left out" with the count.

head: Voice chat
title: Check deeds and stop error loops (V01.0.477)
text: Check deeds and stop error loops (V01.0.477): two protection rules, on by default like the answer check (Settings → Language model, chat.action_check, chat.loop_stop, reason in features.DEFAULT_ON), without a switch per profile (taten.py, fixed rules, no model). Check deeds: every tool that changes something has a kind (taten.KIND: geraet, erinnerung, termin, mail_entwurf, dokument, remarkable, nachricht, merken, aufgabe). Per answer the panel keeps which kind worked (the same failure words as Logs → Requests; "NOT saved yet" counts as a proposal, not as a deed). When a finished sentence claims a deed ("is on now", "I have entered it", "has been sent", "I'll remember", a bare "Done." while something that changes things was offered) and none of the kinds it names worked, it is neither shown nor spoken. At the end comes one fixed sentence: "That did not work: TV." (the tool ran and failed) or "I did not do that." (it did not run); nothing while a proposal is open. No second try. In doubt the sentence is said (it names several deeds and one of them worked). Stop error loops: when the same tool fails twice with the same details (or three times with any), it is not offered again for the

head: Voice chat
title: Check deeds and stop error loops (V01.0.477)
text: rest of the answer, the model hears why, a further call is not run. Visible in Logs → Requests ("Taten-Prüfung", "Schleife gestoppt"), in the journal (chat: action check: held back kind=… reason=…, chat: loop stop: tool=… fails=…) and on the Live page ("Taten-Prüfung": held back and stopped today, numbers only). The settings assistant's rule set will use the same interface taten.check(text, acts, offered) (a fixed "built-in" rule).

head: Voice chat
title: Appointments only fresh from the calendar (V01.0.348)
text: Appointments only fresh from the calendar (V01.0.348): "Guten Morgen" on its own (also with "Spark", "wie geht's") counts as asking for the day: the switch files it under the calendar and the first round has to call daily_briefing (without the briefing: calendar_events). Before another request ("Guten Morgen, turn on the light") it does not. Every calendar result marks appointments that have already ended with "(already over)"; briefing and daily overview do not name them as coming up. Once an answer has read the calendar, the answer check takes times, dates and quoted appointment titles only from the question, the instructions and this answer's results, no longer from earlier answers in the conversation, so yesterday's appointments never come back as today's (tool log: "Termin aus früherer Antwort").

head: Voice chat
title: Learning from corrections (V01.0.118)
text: Learning from corrections (V01.0.118): admin switch Features → "Aus Korrekturen lernen" and a switch per profile (Me → Conversation), both off, never guests or another voice. When a message right after an answer starts like a correction ("Nein, …", "Das stimmt nicht", "Du sollst …", at least three words), the model words a short sentence on the side (fixes.py) and the assistant ends with "Soll ich mir merken: …?". It is stored only after a plain yes from the same conversation within 15 minutes. Never proposed: sentences about code words, PINs, passwords, rules, security, confirmations, locks or alarms, world knowledge (scores, amounts) and links; after mail or outside text there is no proposal, and the earlier answer is then not sent along. The tool log shows a "Korrektur" entry; "Send the question to the admin as a test case" puts the corrected question into quality-cases.json (at most 30) and it runs with the quality test: all tools offered, each finds nothing, made-up figures count as a failure. The admin deletes them under Status → Checks → Quality test.

head: Voice chat
title: Memory check (V01.0.467)
text: Memory check (V01.0.467): admin switch Features → Memory check and a switch per profile (Me → Conversation → "Have my memory checked"), both off, never guests (gedaechtnis.py, plan gedaechtnis-pruefen/plan.md). Every entry keeps its evidence, also while the switch is off: where it came from (said remembered in a conversation, fix from a confirmed correction, auto learned from a quiet conversation, hand changed under Me, tidy from an accepted cleanup proposal), which conversation (own ones only, never to the model) and when it was last confirmed. Entries of older versions count as auto when they were learned, else as said. Fixed rules of the panel, no model, mark: R1 a date it names is more than a day past (never birthdays, "seit", "ab", "jeden"; "Still right" after the date keeps it), R2 "tomorrow", "next week" … older than 14 days or "currently", "right now" … older than 90 days, R3 learned automatically, never confirmed and older than "Learned counts as old after" (setting under Features, 1–60 months, default 6), R4 contradiction: two entries say the same thing with another value (fixed patterns "X is called", "lives in", "works at/as", "drives a", "is married to", "favourite … i

head: Voice chat
title: Memory check (V01.0.467)
text: s", kept apart by whom it is about); the one said or confirmed last wins. Nothing is deleted. The model gets the entries in three blocks: sure, learned (with the month), "maybe outdated, never say it as a fact". Under Me → Memory there are marks (confirmed, learned, outdated?, contradiction), the filter "Outdated", a note card and, on a tap, where from (with "Open the conversation"), remembered, confirmed, the reason and "Still right" (POST /api/profile/memory/{id}/confirm, rate limit "memory"). Live: node "Memory" with counts per mark; Logs: area "Memory" (gedaechtnis: pruefung …, only when the numbers change); Logs → Requests: step "Memory (panel)" with numbers.

head: Voice chat
title: Versions and check-back (V01.0.467)
text: Versions and check-back (V01.0.467): with Memory check on, a confirmed correction about the same thing ("lives in …", "drives a …", "X is called …") becomes a new version of that entry instead of a second entry; ✎ Change keeps the old wording too. Up to 5 earlier versions show in the detail under Me → Memory with "Bring back" (POST /api/profile/memory/{id}/restore, login, profile binding, CSRF, 256 bytes, rate limit). Sub-switch Features → Memory check → "Check back in conversations" (chat.memory_ask) and Me → Conversation → "Check back in conversations" (mem_ask), both off: when an entry that may be out of date fits the question (a shared word, fixed rule), the panel adds "Quick check: is this still right: …?" after the answer. At most once per conversation, three times a day, the same entry once in 30 days; never with someone else's voice, after mail or web pages, during an emergency stop or while another question is open. The answer is open for 15 minutes (users/<id>/memory-ask.json): "yes" confirms, "forget it" deletes, "no" changes nothing, a correction goes through "Learn from corrections" and becomes a new version after a yes. Live shows open questions as a number, Logs → Re
